Request for Sole Source Justification Format >SAT Revision: 04 Effective Date: 12/15/25 Acquisition ID No. 36C250-26-AP-5140

DEPARTMENT OF VETERANS AFFAIRS

Justification and Approval (J&A) For Other Than Full and Open Competition (>SAT) Acquisition Plan Action ID No. 36C250-26-AP-5140

1. Contracting Activity:

Network Contracting Office (NCO) 10 260 East University Avenue Cincinnati, Ohio 45219-2637 Dayton VA Medical Center (VAMC) 4100 West Third Street Dayton, OH 45428-9000 Purchase Request No. 552-26-4-6932-0106.

2. Nature and/or Description of the Action Being Approved:

Project No. 552-26-102, Tunnel G Emergency Steam Repair’s purpose is to repair the existing steam and condensate piping system. This section’s piping is deteriorated, and the supports are failing to support the system as a whole. The section has been shut down as continued operation presents a risk of pipe rupture, a complete steam-system shutdown and potentially catastrophic conditions. Until the repairs are made, no steam/heating services can be provided to the following buildings 115, 116, 118, 119 and 400.

The Independent Government Estimate (IGE) for this project is $2,000,000.00.

3. Description of Supplies/Services Required to Meet the Agency’s Needs:

Project No. 552-26-102, Tunnel G Emergency Steam Repair will have a duration of 210 days and complete all repairs needed. The work includes access through the parking lot and tunnel, demolition and removal of failed piping (900 LF) and supports, installation of new steam and condensate piping (900 LF), installation of new stainless-steel supports and anchorage, hydrostatic testing, and restoration of all disturbed tunnel, asphalt, and grounds areas. Until these repairs are complete, no steam/heating services can be provided for the following facilities: • Bldg. No. 115 - Out-Patient Psychiatric Services. • Bldg. No. 116 - Under Renovation. • Bldg. No. 118 - Medical Center Personnel. • Bldg. No. 119 - Medical Center Personnel. • Bldg. No. 400 - Homeless Veteran Housing/Services.

With fall and winter approaching, the lack of steam/heating services will impede direct patient care, facility operations and limit housing and services to the homeless veteran population. It is vital to the medical center the repairs are made, and the steam/heating services are restored.

Request for Sole Source Justification Format >SAT Revision: 04 Effective Date: 12/15/25 Acquisition ID No. 36C250-26-AP-5140

4. Statutory Authority Permitting Other than Full and Open Competition:

() (1) Only One Responsible Source and No Other Supplies or Services Will Satisfy Agency Requirements per 41 USC §3304(a)(1) as implemented by RFO 6.103-1; (X) (2) Unusual and Compelling Urgency per 41 USC §3304(a)(2) as implemented by RFO 6.103-2; () (3) Industrial Mobilization, Engineering, Developmental or Research Capability or Expert Services per 41 USC §3304(a)(3) as implemented by RFO 6.103-3; () (4) International Agreement per 41 USC §3304(a)(4) as implemented by RFO 6.103-4 () (5) Authorized or Required by Statute per 41 USC §3304(a)(5) as implemented by RFO 6.103-5; () (6) National Security per 41 USC §3304(a)(6) as implemented by RFO 6.103-6; () (7) Public Interest per 41 USC §3304(a)(7) as implemented by RFO 6.103-7;

5. Demonstration that the Contractor’s Unique Qualifications or Nature of the Acquisition Requires the Use of the Authority Cited Above (applicability of authority):

The time involved in competing and awarding the project would delay the repairs needed now and prolong depleted heating operations for the Dayton VA Medical Center.

Buckeye Industrial Piping LLC. is uniquely suited for this project. They completed similar repairs, under contract 36C25024C0046, for section H of the system in FY24. Buckeye specializes in process piping which is needed here. That specialization, prior experience and existing knowledge of the facility and the system make them an ideal partner to complete the urgent repairs and restore the facility to complete functionality.

6. Description of Efforts Made to ensure that offers are solicited from as many potential sources as possible (including whether a notice was or will be publicized as required by RFO Part 5 and, if not, which exception under RFO Part 5 applies):

No effort was made to solicit offers from additional contractors. Buckeye Industrial is uniquely capable of the needed repairs, is already present onsite and ready to begin work.

An award notice and the justification and approval will be posted in accordance with regulation.

7. Determination by the CO that the Anticipated Cost to the Government will be Fair and Reasonable:

The CO will determine the cost for the repairs to be fair and reasonable prior to award. The CO intends to utilize the comparison of the proposed price to the IGE for that determination.

8. Description of the Market Research Conducted and the Results, or a Statement of the Reasons Market Research Was Not Conducted:

The SBA’s Small Business Search data was queried using NAICS code 238220. Located 39 SDVOSB and VOSB firms.

The BAA and TAA apply to this acquisition without exception.

Due to the urgent nature of the repairs needed, additional market research was not completed.

9. Any Other Facts Supporting the Use of Other than Full and Open Competition:

Request for Sole Source Justification Format >SAT Revision: 04 Effective Date: 12/15/25 Acquisition ID No. 36C250-26-AP-5140 In addition to the urgency of this requirement, the requested repairs are minor in their scope compared to the entire system. This project replaces 900 LF of piping. The system itself has 13,980 LF in piping total. This project only addresses repairs needed on 6.4% of the total system.

10. Listening of Sources that Expressed, in Writing, an Interest in the Acquisition:

Buckeye Industrial Piping LLC 11422 Fields RD New Carlisle, OH 45344-9468

11. A Statement of the Actions, if any, the Agency May Take to Remove or Overcome any Barriers to Competition before Making subsequent acquisitions for the supplies or services required:

When repairs of this nature are needed, there is nothing that can be done to overcome barriers to competition. More routine repairs or a total system replacement in the future will provide for full and open competition.

12. Requirements Certification: I certify that the requirement outlined in this justification is a Bona Fide Need of the Department of Veterans Affairs and that the supporting data under my cognizance, which are included in the justification, are accurate and complete to the best of my knowledge and belief.

_____________________________ ________________________ Jason Dahal Date Energy Manager Dayton VA Medical Center

13. Approvals in accordance with the VHAPM Part 806.3 OFOC SOP: a. Contracting Officer Certification (required): I certify that the foregoing justification is accurate and complete to the best of my knowledge and belief.
